problem: Which set is equivalent to $A={n\in N:4n+7=-9}?$
worked_solution:
The elements of the given set are the natural numbers that satisfy the equation $4n+7=-9.$ 

So, we first need to solve our equation for $n:$

$$
\begin{aligned}4n+7 & =-9 \\ 4n & =-16 \\ n & =-4\end{aligned}
$$

However, since $-4\notin N,$ we conclude that the set $A$ contains no elements. Hence, $A=∅.$
